description: Frozen synthetic corpus for the Search v2 relevance gate (Task S1). Every note is invented; nothing here comes from a real Vault. `raw` is written byte-for-byte to a temporary Vault, so the index, evaluator, and retrieval path under test are the production ones. Edits to this file invalidate the frozen fixture hash in qrels.json. Notes are written oldest-first: array order is the file-time order, and the index settles equal scores by recency, so the array order is part of the frozen fixture.
